style: Structured possession from a flexible back line, controlled build-up through De Jong, with width and directness feeding Gakpo and Depay.
recent_form: Qualified under Ronald Koeman as a top-eight ranked side; hit by late injuries to key defenders ahead of the tournament.

key_players.name: Virgil van Dijk
key_players.note: Commanding centre-back who organises the defence and brings calm in big games.

key_players.name: Frenkie de Jong
key_players.note: Barcelona midfielder who dictates tempo and progresses the ball through the lines.

key_players.name: Cody Gakpo
key_players.note: Versatile, powerful Liverpool attacker providing goals and width.

key_players.name: Memphis Depay
key_players.note: Experienced forward leading the attack and a key creative and scoring outlet.

key_players.name: Tijjani Reijnders
key_players.note: Man City midfielder offering energy, passing range and goal threat.

key_players.name: Denzel Dumfries
key_players.note: Powerful Inter wing-back delivering width and a direct aerial threat.

historical_news: Three-time World Cup runners-up (1974, 1978, 2010) but never champions.
Total Football heritage remains a defining national identity.
Late injury blows: Jurrien Timber forced out pre-tournament, Jeremie Frimpong omitted injured.
Koeman tasked with turning a talented squad into a deep tournament run.
Van Dijk's leadership central to expectations of a knockout-stage push.

media_sentiment.label: neutral
media_sentiment.summary: Respected dark horse, but injuries and questions over cohesion temper expectations.
